items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And he had Foots Thomas and his brother

ctx.x: And before you left for Boston? So about how long do you think that was that you were with him here in New York?

Oh, I don't know. I think we did about 16 weeks, I think. Yeah. And that was a great experience because I played Ethel Waters' act and I think we...I don't know if it was Broadway, it was a different situation and Joe Howard owned the place and it was really the big time. And I got to meet her pianist, Reginald Bean, who was a very gifted, gifted, gifted pianist and he was her accompaniest and we became quite friendly. I understand he works for ASCAP now. And Don Redman had the intermission band. Yeah. And he had…
